process.title: Enquiry & Registration
process.description: Visit the school office or fill out the online enquiry form. Collect the admission application from the office or download it from our website.

process.title: Submit Application
process.description: Complete the application form and submit it along with required documents and the application fee at the school office.

process.title: Entrance Assessment
process.description: Students appear for a grade-appropriate assessment in English, Mathematics, and General Knowledge. Primary section students have an informal interaction.

process.title: Interview & Interaction
process.description: A brief interaction with the student and parents to understand the child's interests, strengths, and any special needs.

process.title: Confirmation & Enrollment
process.description: Selected students receive an admission offer. Complete the enrollment by paying the admission fee and submitting original documents.
